The four tables list every atom of one conventional cubic cell of four crystals (files named by crystal). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights and first-order Bragg diffraction; the relevant peak is the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity. Weights: C26 H12 Cu O4: C = 6, Cu = 29, H = 1, O = 8; silicon: Si = 14; halite: Cl = 17, Na = 11; periclase: Mg = 12, O = 8. For X-rays of wavelength 0.70930 Å, you must choose the crystal whose lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity lies closest to 2θ = 1.50° (for example, to calibrate a detector at that angle). Which crystal should you choose?

A. silicon (COD9008565-cell.txt)
B. C26 H12 Cu O4 (COD4118591-cell.txt)
C. halite (COD9008678-cell.txt)
D. periclase (COD1000053-cell.txt)
